title: CCPA fines Narayana Educational Institutions ₹8 lakh for misleading JEE Advanced ads
description: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) recently imposed a penalty of ₹8 lakh on Narayana Educational Institutions for publishing misleading advertisements about its students’ performance in the JEE Advanced 2024 examination.The order dated June 11 was passed by a Bench comprising Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare and Commissioner Anupam Mishra.
